fact: Andersen says Botswana's tax rules in force from 1 July 2026 make electronic billing and invoicing mandatory and support tax administration with digital filing, with compliance deadlines still to apply.

The Ministry of Finance, as reported on 2025-10-31, seeks P4.13 billion for the Botswana Unified Revenue Service in the NDP 12 programme, with projects including the rollout of electronic VAT invoicing and digital taxation for online services.
The Bank of Botswana said digitalisation of revenue collection, announced in 2023, is nearing completion pending integration with the Botswana Unified Revenue Service and the Accountant General.
